Cleanse to make something clean. Complicate to make something difficult or complex. Celebrate  to  do  something  special  or enjoyable for an important event, occasion, holiday, etc.
Sol.261.(c) Insignificance -lacking meaning or importance. Frivolity  behaviour  that is silly and not serious. Consequence the result or outcome of a particular action or event. Substantial  large in size, value  or importance. Meaningful having a clear meaning that people can understand.
Sol.262.(c) Stern -firm, strict, or uncompromising. Austere strict or severe in manner. Morose -unhappy or annoyed and unwilling  to  speak, smile, or be pleasant to people. Aged grown old. Composed  having  one's  feelings  and expression under control.

Plead make an emotional appeal. Request an act of asking for something. Petition a formal application to a court for a writ, judicial action in a suit, etc. Claim  a  statement  that  something  is true, although you have not proved it.
Synonyms
Sol.267.(c) Manipulative -skillful in influencing  or controlling others to one's advantage. Calculating -using other people or situations as a way to get something you want. Unscrupulous lacking moral principles. Unsympathetic -showing no compassion or concern for others. Callous -insensitive and unfeeling
toward others.
Sol.268.(a) Pitiful very small or poor. Lousy very poor or bad. Praiseworthy  deserving  approval  and admiration. Moral  relating  to  beliefs about what is right or wrong. Funny that makes you smile or laugh.
